title: All-cleft 句
titleEn: Using the All-cleft to emphasise the only or most important point

omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: All + subject + verb + be + focused noun / phrase / clause

formulas.formula: All + subject + verb + be + focused noun / phrase / clause
All + subject + do / does / did + be + base verb

formulas.labelZh: 強調唯一需要完成的行動
formulas.formula: All + subject + have / has / had to do + be + base verb
All that + verb + be + focused information

example: All I want for Christmas is you.
exampleZh: 我聖誕節想要的只有你。

examples.en: All I want for Christmas is you.
examples.zh: 我聖誕節想要的只有你。
examples.highlight: All I want for Christmas is you.

examples.en: All you need to succeed is hard work and time.
examples.zh: 要成功，你所需要的只是努力和時間。
examples.highlight: All you need to succeed is hard work and time.

rules.zh: All 在這個句型中通常表示「唯一的事物」 這裏的 all 通常不是指「所有人」或「所有東西」，而是接近： （我唯一需要的就是你的幫助。）
rules.en: In this structure, All normally means “the only thing”. Here, all does not usually mean “all people” or “all things”; it is closer to “the only thing that ...”, “the only action that ...”, or “everything that ...”. For example, All I need is your help means The only thing I need is your help.
examples: the only thing that……
the only action that……
everything that……
All I need is your help.
= The only thing I need is your help.

rules.zh: All 後面必須有一個不完整的子句 在以下句子中，need 後面缺少受詞： 因此，All I need 的意思是「我所需要的一切／我唯一需要的東西」。
rules.en: All must be followed by an incomplete clause. In All I need is some water, need is missing its object: I need what? The answer is some water. Thus, All I need means “everything I need” or “the only thing I need”.
examples: All I need is some water.
I need what?
some water

rules.zh: 本練習使用 is 或 was 整個 All + 子句 被視為一項資料或一件事情，因此本練習使用單數動詞： 即使後面的重點部分是複數，本練習仍以 is / was 作為標準答案。
rules.en: Use is or was in this exercise. The whole All + clause is treated as one piece of information or one thing, so this exercise uses a singular verb. Even when the focused element that follows is plural, is or was remains the standard answer: All I need is two pens; All she wanted was two tickets.
examples: All I need is two pens.
All she wanted was two tickets.

rules.zh: 時態必須配合句子的時間 現在的情況通常使用 is： （我想要的只是一點安寧。） 過去的情況通常使用 was： （我當時想要的只是一點安寧。）
rules.en: The tense must match the time of the sentence. Present situations normally use is, as in All I want is some peace. Past situations normally use was, as in All I wanted was some peace.
examples: All I want is some peace.
All I wanted was some peace.

rules.zh: 使用 did 時，was 後面接原形動詞 因為 did 已經表達過去時，所以後面的行動使用原形動詞。
rules.en: When the All-clause uses did, follow was with the base form of the verb. Because did already marks the past tense, the following action remains in the base form: All Grace did was smile, not All Grace did was smiled.
examples: All Grace did was smile.
All Grace did was smiled.

rules.zh: have to do 後面的行動也使用原形動詞 （你只須按下按鈕。） 不要寫成：
rules.en: The action after have to do also uses the base form. Write All you have to do is press the button, not All you have to do is pressing the button.
examples: All you have to do is press the button.
All you have to do is pressing the button.

rules.zh: 重點部分可以有不同形式 重點部分可以是： 名詞： All I need is a pen. 代名詞： All I want is you. 原形動詞： All he did was wait. 其他資料： All I remember is where we met.
rules.en: The focused element can take different forms: a noun (All I need is a pen), a pronoun (All I want is you), a to-infinitive (All she wants is to go home), a base-form verb (All he did was wait), a that-clause (All we know is that the door is locked), or other information (All I remember is where we met).
examples: to-infinitive： All she wants is to go home.
that-clause： All we know is that the door is locked.

benefits.zh: 清楚突出最重要的重點 這個句型能讓讀者或聽者立即知道，哪一件事才是句子中最重要的重點。 （最重要的只有你的安全。）
benefits.en: It clearly highlights the main point This structure tells the listener or reader that one particular thing is the main focus. All that matters is your safety.
examples: All that matters is your safety.

benefits.zh: 把較長的解釋濃縮成一句 你不需要使用兩句重複的句子，也可以把相關資料合併成一句。 中文比較： 我只需要一樣東西。我需要你的幫助。 我所需要的只有你的幫助。
benefits.en: It can shorten a longer explanation Instead of using two repetitive sentences, you can combine the information into one clear sentence. I need only one thing. I need your help. All I need is your help.
examples: I need only one thing. I need your help.
All I need is your help.

benefits.zh: 讓指示簡單而直接 使用 All you have to do is...，可以清楚說明某項任務只有一個主要步驟，讓指示更容易理解。 （你只須掃描二維碼。）
benefits.en: It makes instructions simple and direct The pattern All you have to do is... is useful when explaining that a task is easy or contains only one main step. All you have to do is scan the code.
examples: All you have to do is scan the code.

benefits.zh: 提供容易使用的口語框架 掌握這個句型後，你可以直接把自己的資料放入框架中，不必由第一個字開始重新組織整句。
benefits.en: It provides a useful speaking frame Once you know the pattern, you can quickly organise an answer without planning every word from the beginning. All I want is... All I know is... All I can say is... All we have to do is...
examples: All I want is...
All I know is...
All I can say is...
All we have to do is...

benefits.zh: 避免句子開頭過度重複 你不必反覆以 I want、I need、I know 或 I did 開始句子。All-cleft 句能增加句式變化，同時加強 語氣重點。
benefits.en: It helps avoid repetitive sentence openings Instead of repeatedly beginning sentences with I want, I need, I know or I did, you can use an All-cleft to create sentence variety and stronger emphasis.
examples: All-cleft to create sentence variety and stronger emphasis.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.
